overall_notes: The paper focuses on factual inconsistency detection in long document summarization. It evaluates NLG systems but the main contribution is the evaluation framework itself (STRUCTSCORE) rather than generating new content. Human evaluation was conducted on the LEGALSUMM dataset with legal experts. The extraction was generally accurate but contained some duplication and over-detailed descriptions that needed simplification.
